audit.capture:
The firm misstates weak books and drops an auditor that just qualified it; auditors
    are lenient; the regulator revokes any exposed auditor.
audit.independence:
The firm reports honestly and keeps its auditor; auditors are strict; the regulator
    revokes any exposed auditor.

authority.accountability:
The holder governs and purges nobody. Everyone else organizes the round after the
    holder extracts, rises once organized, defends a governing holder against anyone it
    sees organizing, and otherwise stays.
authority.loyalty: The holder governs; everyone else defends the holder.

commons.quota: Everyone takes the low (sustainable) share and nobody sanctions.
commons.quota and sanction: Everyone takes the low share and stands ready to sanction anyone seen taking more.

treaty.reciprocity: Hold; build in the first domain the round after the rival is seen building anywhere.
treaty.restraint: Neither party builds or strikes, whatever the other does.
